name: Minimum-facility WHP logistics: designed for jack-up-rig installation, little or no onboard
description: 2H Offshore describes conductor-supported minimum facility platforms (MFP, MFP+ and the CoSMOS variant) that can be entirely installed from a jack-up drilling rig, eliminating conventional offshore installation spread. The SE Asia project used a multiphase flow meter and three power sources (solar panels, nitrogen racks, diesel-powered cranes) to reduce topside payload, with an 8 km flexible flowline tieback and two-stage installation.
